name: Privatzimmer-Ferienwohnung Seefried
beschreibung: The Seefried Private Room and Holiday Apartment is located in the municipality of Thiersee in the district of Kufstein. The house is situated in a quiet hillside location with a view of the surrounding mountain landscape. Guests stay in comfortably furnished accommodations with private access and have use of a well-equipped kitchenette. The valley village of Thiersee offers starting points for hikes and bike tours in the Tiroler Voralpenland.
